engine: Chromium; complete HTML; isolated synthetic accounts and email transport
tests: Organization-only account opens its hub and invite tools without a team or team switch prompt
Phone invite form separates title, scope and permissions without horizontal overflow
Lost creation response retains form and retries the same secure invitation
Share link uses public app URL; blocked copying shows manual fallback without false success
Email failure is visible; retry preserves link and request identity and reports submission only
Pending invitations can be revoked; full administrator access is explicit
Late invitation responses cannot overwrite another organization tab
Acceptance previews access, requires consent and can be cancelled without granting a role
Limited leader accepts directly into the organization without team membership or administrator invite tools
Wrong-email rejection appears in the invitation form and grants nothing
Account change closes the consent dialog without granting access
WMO link selects leadership signup, survives email confirmation and reload, and resumes with explicit consent
Integrated app completes without JavaScript errors
